body.name: 2.2.0-pre
body.body: #178 - Add support for running local LLMs via LLaMA C/C++ port

### Removed
- Functionality to fetch/use OpenAI account name

### Fixed
- Rendering user input's newlines

### Added
- Support for closing other tabs (#172)
- Support for configuring custom hosts for OpenAI and Azure services

### Fixed
- Empty editor context menu item text (#137)
- Temp file path resolving (#130)

### Improved
- Response streaming

### Added
- Reset chat window toolbar action (#138)

### Fixed
- Settings deserialization error

### Improved
- Memory consumption by disposing unused editors which are no longer needed

### Removed
- Main editor focus stealing on response streaming

### Added
- New GPT-3.5-16k model 

### Fixed
- NPE when `displayName` couldn't be fetched

### Improved
- Proxy support by disabling the default trustmanager

### Removed
- Off-screen rendering setting option
- Automatic textarea focus on stream completion (#126)

## Added
- Automatic retry logic on stream timeouts
## Improved
- Input prompt text field UI/UX (height grows with the content)
## Removed
- Custom prompt editor action (users can now provide custom actions within the chat window itself)
## Replaced
- ToolWindow HTML content with native Swing components
## Secured
- OPENAI_API_KEY persistence, key is saved in the OS password safe from now on
### Added - Support custom server/model configuration, allowing easy integration with LocalAI and Langchain - Support API Key retrieval from environment variable

### Added
- Keymap support for plugin actions
- Support for off-screen browser rendering

### Added
- Support for both Azure authentication methods

### Added
- Azure OpenAI Service support

### Fixed
- Some known bugs

### Added
- Support for display name and organization configuration

### Improved
- Displaying error messages

### Fixed
- Build warning logs
- Settings sync on tab changes

### Added
- GPT-4 32k model
- Hand cursor for conversation panel
- Project codestyle rules

### Removed
- Custom prompt textarea (will be replaced with the IDE editor component)

### Added
- Support for seamless conversation (Chat models only)
- Custom scrollbar design

### Added
- Option to delete previous messages

### Improved
- Replace Selection logic

### Added
- Ability to copy and replace generated code in editor

### Removed
- Data usage support

### Fixed
- Code from overflowing #75

### Added
- New Chat UI
- Ability to parse and render markdown

### Fixed
- Text input placeholder

### Added
- Secondary set of tabs to chat with the AI simultaneously

### Added
- Dialog confirmation when clearing all conversations (#57)

### Replaced
- OpenaI API client implementation

### Removed
- Support for unofficial reverse proxy

### Fixed
- Response regeneration (#51)

### Replaced
- Account details calls to async
- Plugin's description

### Fixed
- Display credit usage on tab change

### Added
- Relative font size

### Disabled
- Support for unofficial reverse proxy (#43)

### Added
- GPT-4 model
- New Chat toolbar
  - Start new conversations
  - Open the conversation in the editor
  - Display credit usage
- New Conversation History toolbar
  - Delete all conversations
  - Delete single conversation

### Fixes
- ToolWindow's NPE

### Reverted
- Chat model renaming (causing deserialization issues with previously saved conversations)

### Fixed
- ToolWindow's NPE when reopening the project

### Added
- Support for creating completely new actions or overriding/deleting the default ones
- Advanced settings panel (requires to enter the proxy settings again)

### Fixed
- Force change the model on conversation change
- Start new conversation on model change

### Replaced
- Unofficial ChatGPT reverse proxy

### Added
- Proxy auth support

### Improved
- Append response text outside of the main GUI thread

### Added
- Conversation history and ability to restore previous sessions
- Display the most recent conversation when opening the project

### Fixed
- Settings id collision with other plugins
- Clear TextArea placeholder

### Improved
- Overall visuals for default and dark theme

### Replaced
- Editor actions menu placement

### Added:
- Stop/re-generate response logic
- Preserve previous user custom prompt
- Visual improvements

### Fixed
- Wait until message has been written to text area on the event dispatch thread

### Added
- Proxy support

### Replaced
- Underlying client's logic

### Fixed
- ToolWindow not being registered when multiple projects are opened

### Removed
- Action group disabling when API key missing

### Added
- Support for the official ChatGPT API

### Replaced
- Plugin's name and logo ([https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use))

### Added
- Ability to execute custom prompts
- Block caret when typing
- Other improvements

### Remove
- Block caret when appending the response

### Support
- Downgrade to Java 11 to support older IDE builds

### Added
- Improved error handling
- Add blinking block caret after end of the response

### Added
- Option to choose between different language models

### Removed
- Missing API key notification on startup

### Added
- Reverse proxy support for the real ChatGPT

### Fixed
- TextArea copy and selection

### Added
- Markdown code syntax highlighting
- Copy functionality

### Removed
- Plugin required for restart
